mapper.insert: insert into clazz ( name, master_id, begin_date, end_date, create_time, update_time,subject, room) values ( #{name}, #{masterId}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{subject}, #{room} )
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name},
master_id = #{masterId},
begin_date = #{beginDate},
end_date = #{endDate},
subject = #{subject},
room = #{room},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select c.*, e.name as masterName from clazz c left join emp e on c.master_id = e.id where c.id = #{id};
